title: Daily life: doctor, bank, shop
intro: Everyday English for real errands: describe symptoms to a doctor, buy medicine, open a bank account, return things in a shop and deal with your landlord.
introBn: প্রতিদিনের কাজের ইংরেজি: ডাক্তারকে উপসর্গ বলা, ওষুধ কেনা, ব্যাংক অ্যাকাউন্ট খোলা, দোকানে জিনিস ফেরত দেওয়া আর বাড়িওয়ালার সাথে কথা বলা।

units.title: At the doctor and the pharmacy
units.idea: To describe symptoms, say what hurts, how long it has lasted and how bad it is. Use present perfect with 'for' and 'since' for how long.
units.ideaBn: উপসর্গ বলতে কী হচ্ছে, কতদিন ধরে আর কতটা খারাপ তা বলুন। কতদিন ধরে বোঝাতে present perfect + for/since।

formula.name: Symptoms
formula.pos: I've got a headache. · I have a sore throat. · My back hurts.

formula.name: How long
formula.pos: I've had a fever since Tuesday. · I've been coughing for three days.

formula.name: Pharmacy
formula.pos: Do you have anything for a cold? · How often should I take it? · Do I need a prescription?

uses.ex: I've had a headache since yesterday morning.

uses.rule: Common symptom phrases: a sore throat, a runny nose, a temperature, a cough.
uses.ex: I've got a runny nose and a slight temperature.

uses.rule: Use 'hurt' for pain: My … hurts / It hurts when I…
uses.ex: My knee hurts when I climb the stairs.

uses.rule: At the pharmacy: Do you have anything for…?
uses.bn: ফার্মেসিতে Do you have anything for…?
uses.ex: Do you have anything for an upset stomach?
How many tablets should I take, and how often?

traps.wrong: I am having fever from yesterday.
traps.right: I've had a fever since yesterday.
traps.bn: from নয়, since; আর a fever।

traps.right: I've got a headache. / My head hurts.
traps.why: 'Pain' is not used as a verb like this.
traps.bn: is paining ভুল; hurts বা headache বলুন।

traps.right: Do you have anything for a cold?
traps.why: Medicine for something; a polite question.
traps.bn: of নয়, for; প্রশ্ন করে চান।

drills.s: I've had a sore throat ___ Sunday.
I've ___ a headache since this morning.

drills.q: আমার পেট খারাপ। এর জন্য কিছু আছে?
o: I've got an upset stomach. Do you have anything for it?
My stomach is bad. Any medicine of it?
I have stomach upset. Give something.
My stomach paining. You have anything?
drills.a: I've got an upset stomach. Do you have anything for it?

o: My back hurts when I sit for a long time.
My back is hurting since a week.
drills.a: My back hurts when I sit for a long time.

drills.s: How ___ should I take these tablets?
Take one tablet twice a day ___ meals.

drills.q: Doctor in Singapore: "How long have you felt like this?"
drills.s: "I've ___ dizzy since I got off the plane."

drills.q: Pick the clearest description for a doctor.
o: I've had a high temperature and a bad cough for four days, and it hurts when I breathe deeply.
I feel not good since many days.
drills.a: I've had a high temperature and a bad cough for four days, and it hurts when I breathe deeply.

units.title: Bank, shopping and renting
units.idea: At the bank, in shops and with landlords you ask questions, make requests and sometimes complain. Be clear about what you want and polite about how you ask.
units.ideaBn: ব্যাংক, দোকান আর বাড়িওয়ালার সাথে প্রশ্ন, অনুরোধ, কখনও অভিযোগ করতে হয়। কী চান তা পরিষ্কার, কিন্তু চাওয়ার ধরন ভদ্র রাখুন।

formula.name: Bank
formula.pos: I'd like to open a savings account. · What documents do I need? · Is there a minimum balance?

formula.name: Shop & returns
formula.pos: I'd like to return this, please. · Could I exchange it for a bigger size? · Here's the receipt.

formula.name: Renting
formula.pos: Is the rent negotiable? · Are bills included? · Could you get the tap fixed, please?

uses.rule: Open an account: I'd like to open…
uses.bn: অ্যাকাউন্ট খুলতে I'd like to open…
uses.ex: I'd like to open a savings account. What documents do I need?

uses.rule: Returns: return (get money back) vs exchange (swap).
uses.ex: Could I exchange this shirt for a large?

uses.rule: Renting questions: Are … included? Is … negotiable?
uses.ex: Are gas and electricity included in the rent?

uses.rule: Requests to a landlord: get + thing + fixed/repaired.
uses.bn: কিছু ঠিক করিয়ে দিতে get … fixed।
uses.ex: Could you get the bathroom light fixed this week?

uses.rule: Describe faults with 'doesn't work' / 'is broken' / 'is leaking'.
uses.bn: ত্রুটি বোঝাতে doesn't work, is leaking।

traps.wrong: I want to return back this.
traps.right: I'd like to return this, please.

traps.wrong: The fan is not working from last week.
traps.right: The fan hasn't been working since last week.

traps.wrong: Please fix the tap urgently, otherwise I will not pay rent.
traps.right: The kitchen tap is leaking. Could you get it fixed this week, please?
traps.why: Threats damage the relationship; ask clearly first.
traps.bn: প্রথমেই হুমকি নয়; পরিষ্কার ও ভদ্রভাবে অনুরোধ করুন।

drills.s: I'd like to ___ a savings account.
What documents do I ___ to bring?
Could I exchange this ___ a smaller size?

drills.q: বিদ্যুৎ বিল কি ভাড়ার মধ্যে ধরা?
o: Is electricity included in the rent?
Electricity bill is inside the rent?
drills.a: Is electricity included in the rent?

o: I want to return back this phone.
I'd like to return this phone. It stopped working after two days.
Take back this phone, it is not working from two days.
drills.a: I'd like to return this phone. It stopped working after two days.

drills.s: Could you get the kitchen tap ___, please? It's leaking.
Do you have the ___? We can't give a refund without it.

drills.q: Rafi talks to his new landlord in Dhaka.
drills.s: The water pump ___ working since Friday.

drills.q: Pick the most natural question when renting a flat.
o: The rent is how much negotiable?
Is the rent negotiable at all?
Can rent be less or not?
drills.a: Is the rent negotiable at all?

mastery.s: I've had this cough ___ two weeks.

o: My tooth is paining since yesterday.
My tooth has been hurting since yesterday.
I have tooth pain from yesterday.
mastery.a: My tooth has been hurting since yesterday.

mastery.s: Do you have anything ___ a sore throat?

mastery.q: আমি এটা একটা বড় সাইজের সাথে বদলাতে চাই।
o: I'd like to exchange this for a bigger size.
I want to change this with big size.
I'd like to exchange this to a bigger size.
mastery.a: I'd like to exchange this for a bigger size.

mastery.s: Is there a minimum ___ for this account?
Could you get the lock ___ this week?
